content.short: ChangeNOW provides instant crypto swaps and exchange APIs with fixed or floating rates across many assets, including TON.
content.description: ChangeNOW is a non-custodial crypto exchange service built for quick asset swaps on the web and through partner integrations. Its consumer flow focuses on exchanging one asset for another without opening a trading interface, while the business side offers an API for wallets, exchanges, payment products, and other Web3 services. Official materials highlight broad asset coverage, fixed and standard rate modes, cross-chain exchange support, and optional fiat ramps for partners. In the TON context, ChangeNOW is best understood as an access and liquidity tool rather than a native TON application.
content.meta: Browse ChangeNOW, a non-custodial swap service and exchange API with fixed or floating rates, partner tools, and TON support.
